ria_marketing: Quick ask — marketing needs a smoke run for launch claims (gen p95, embed p95, cost/1k). Can runtime take a focused sanity check today?

sam_runtime: We can. Quick clarifiers: which model tags and which payload pack? Smoke size? Cold-starts? Where to deposit artifacts?

ria_marketing: Models: redwood-alpha-7b:fp16 (2026-03-01) and redwood-alpha-7b:quant8 (2026-03-05). Payload: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/payloads/launch-mini-pack.json. Smoke = 30 samples each. Full = gen 8k / long 1k / embeds 5k. Include cold-start (first after 5m idle) + steady-state. Drop to s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-3000001234/ with embargo. Tolerances proposal: p95 +/-10% and cost <=15%.

anya_legal: Legal prefers those tolerances. Also request a one-line human summary per model and an embargoed blurb for the press kit.

sam_runtime: Plan: smoke today with seed=20260410, report per-request CSV, 30 raw traces, percentile PNGs, and draft one-line summaries. Smoke ETA ~1h. Perf CLI we will include.

ops_bot: s3 folder created and ACL set to embargo until 2026-04-12. Watchers: marketing, platform-metrics.

perf-bot: queued bench-3000001234-smoke (est 1h).

perf-bot: bench-3000001234-smoke finished — summary at s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-3000001234/smoke/summary.csv. Preliminary: fp16 gen p95 170ms, quant8 gen p95 188ms (+11%), embed p95 (batch8) 26ms, est cost delta quant8 ~12% lower. Raw traces uploaded.

sam_runtime: Draft one-liners (prelim):
- redwood-alpha-7b:fp16 — p95 gen 170ms (steady-state), baseline cost.
- redwood-alpha-7b:quant8 — p95 gen 188ms (+11%), cost ~12% lower on this payload.
- Embeddings (batch8) — p95 26ms.
Perf CLI (repro): `redwood-bench run --model redwood-alpha-7b:fp16 --model redwood-alpha-7b:quant8 --payload s3://redwood-internal/marketing/payloads/launch-mini-pack.json --samples 30 --seed 20260410 --out s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-3000001234/smoke/`

ria_marketing: Excellent — we'll draft copy against these. If full sweep confirms we'll request legal sign-off. Please ping #marketing when full sweep is queued.

sam_runtime: Will do. If smoke passes tolerances we'll schedule full sweep Tue night and attach final artifacts + polished summaries. If any surprises, we'll include root cause and mitigation notes.
